text: Tampa Bay won the first period, and that was enough. TBL out-chanced WSH 1.62 expected goals to 0.41 in the opening 20 minutes and turned it into a 2-0 lead on goals from Charle-Edouard D'Astous and Conor Geekie, both set up by Brandon Hagel and Jake Guentzel. Both were modest chances (0.078 and 0.045 expected goals), so the score did not overstate the early play. Over 60 min
